topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out that the building I've been calling home is switching over to condos. I guess things are changing around here, and I'm not quite sure what that means for me. The idea of having to buy or move isn’t something I’ve really considered. I’m taking some time to think through what my options are, weigh the pros and cons, and maybe talk to a few friends or a counselor to get some advice. Change brings new opportunities, and I’m sure there’s a good path forward, I just need to take a moment to figure out what that looks like.
